title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
firstLine: Marley was dead: to begin with.
begins: The story says Marley, Scrooge’s partner, is dead, and that Scrooge signed the burial register. Scrooge, a tight-fisted old man of business, then spends Christmas Eve in his counting-house refusing his nephew and charity collectors.
happens: On Christmas Eve, miserly Ebenezer Scrooge rebuffs his nephew Fred and grudges his clerk Bob Cratchit Christmas Day off. Marley’s ghost warns him of three spirits. The Ghost of Christmas Past shows his lonely youth and Fezziwig’s ball. The Ghost of Christmas Present shows the Cratchits’ dinner and the sickly Tiny Tim. The Ghost of Christmas Yet to Come shows Tiny Tim’s death and Scrooge’s own grave. Scrooge wakes reformed on Christmas morning, sends a prize turkey to the Cratchits, joins Fred’s party, raises Bob’s salary and becomes a second father to Tiny Tim.

characters.name: Tiny Tim
characters.who: Cratchit's sickly little son, who walks with a crutch
